verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: satigur naanak dheau hai paramesur soiee|

en.bdb: Guru Nanak is the true Guru and is God Himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gur a(n)gadh gur a(n)g te jotee jot samoiee|

en.bdb: From the limb of this Guru was created Guru Angad and his flame merged in his (Guru Angad' s ) flame.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਾਪਦ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦਹੁਂ ਹੁਇ ਜਾਣੁ ਜਣੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: amaraapadh gur a(n)gadhahu(n) hui jaan janoiee|

en.bdb: From Guru Angad the omniscient Guru Amar Das emerged who was given the status of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਹੁਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gur amarahu(n) guroo raamadhaas a(n)mirat ras bhoiee|

en.bdb: From Amar Das came into being Guru Ram Das who was quaffer of the nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਹੁਂ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸਥੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: raamadhaasahu(n) arajan guroo gur sabadh sathoiee|

en.bdb: From Ram Das came Guru Arjan Dev, the companion of the Guru's word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜਨਹੁਂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: harigovi(n)dh gur arajanahu(n) gur govi(n)dh hoiee|

en.bdb: From Guru Arjan emerged Guru Hargobind, Guru and God in one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਅਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras satisa(n)g aloiee|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs in the holy congregation came face to face of the pleasure fruit of loving delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਹੁਂ ਬਾਹਿਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੋਈ ॥੨੦॥੩੮॥
verses.translit_en: gur govi(n)dhahu(n) baahiraa dhoojaa nahee(n) koiee ||20||38||

en.bdb: Nothing in this world is outside the Guru and God.
